mods.name: REI Craftable Fix (our own)
mods.pinned_reason: Our own client mod (source: minecraftServer/rei-craftable-fix on the host PC). Stops REI 16's craftable-only list from rebuilding every 5 ticks (tooltip flicker) when only an item's component hash changed. Update by rebuilding, uploading a new GitHub release, and editing this entry by hand.

key_layout.why: The host's own key bindings (saved with tools/export-keys.ps1), so every PC's controls match. Keys a PC lacks always get it; sync -MatchKeys or a first-time setup sets all of them

config_fixes.why: With First-person Model, a hat in the Accessories slot rendered stretched and untextured across your own first-person view (bobbing, motion sickness). Hides hats only in your own first-person view; they still show in third person and to other players
REI's 'show recipe' on R also triggered Inventory Profiles Next's sort; recipe moves to Y, next to REI's U for uses
AutoSwitch swapped to flint and steel when right-clicking a creeper, which lights it
MCA's first-join 'Where will your journey start?' screen could teleport a player away from their base; the character creator still shows
Distant Horizons defaults to 256 chunks of far terrain, which maxed out the host laptop's GPU. With C2ME, Lithium, and Sodium, 128 runs smoothly (tested 10/23/2026); 256 is still too far
Moves PCs that still have the pack's old 48-chunk setting up to the new 128. Any other value is a player's own choice and stays
Distant Horizons: 16x fewer far-terrain pieces near the edge of view
Distant Horizons: simpler far-off overhangs and caves
Distant Horizons: no extra full-screen shading pass (shaders shade anyway)
Distant Horizons: no far-off clouds (vanilla clouds are off too)
Distant Horizons: far-off water drawn solid, saving a pass
Distant Horizons: build only the rough surface for far terrain, not full chunks

config_files.why: Inventory Profiles Next's sort and move buttons sat on top of Traveler's Backpack's own buttons (its 'Move Matching Items' covered the backpack's three-dots button); they're hidden on the backpack screen only, and R still sorts

host_world_datapacks.note: Data pack for the HOST's world only (put in <world>/datapacks). Not installed by sync.ps1. Installed in Reajustiene (the main world, added 2026-10-18) and Catch em All!. A new world needs it copied in by hand.
